metadata.title: Defense AI Heats Up: BigBear.ai Lands First European Validation for AI-Powered Airport Screening

content.text:
By Karen Roman
BigBear.ai Holdings, Inc. (NYSE: BBAI) said its Pangiam Threat Detection solution received Dutch national approval from the Netherlands' National Coordinator for Counterterrorism and Security. The authorization comes after Pangiam was tested by TNO, the Netherlands Organisation for Applied Scientific Research headquartered in The Hague, it said.
Pangiam is BigBear.ai's AI-enabled screening platform for aviation security operations, and this milestone supports this platform's integration with CT screening infrastructure and airport security workflows, the company stated.

"For aviation security operators, trust is critical when introducing automation in regulated, high-consequence environments," said Kevin McAleenan, BigBear.ai CEO. "This approval is an important validation of Pangiam Threat Detection and of our focus on delivering mission-ready AI that supports officers and supervisors as screening operations become more automated and operationally demanding."
